text: My most memorable trip was to Japan. Planning it took months, as I researched train passes and booked cozy guesthouses. The moment I arrived, I was struck by the new culture—the calm order of the streets and the polite bows. Food was a highlight, especially the steaming ramen from tiny shop stalls. However, language barriers were real; I often relied on pointing at menus and simple gestures. Despite the awkward moments, sharing smiles with locals made it worthwhile. Now, those vivid memories of neon lights and temple bells are my favorite souvenirs. I can’t wait to plan my next adventure.
